mapper.select: -- 같은 작업/고정 입력/유효 lease의 성공 근거만 읽는다. 다른 generation의 binary 재확인을 생략하지 않는다. SELECT c.file_result_json::text FROM announcement_attachment_file_checkpoints c JOIN announcement_attachment_jobs j ON j.id=c.job_id AND j.source_id=c.source_id JOIN announcement_source_snapshots s ON s.id=j.source_id JOIN announcement_source_classification_evaluations e ON e.id=j.base_evaluation_id AND e.source_id=s.id AND e.content_version_id=j.content_version_id AND e.rule_release_id=j.rule_release_id AND e.is_current WHERE c.job_id=#{jobId} AND c.stable_locator_hash=#{locatorHash} AND j.lease_token=#{leaseToken} AND j.job_status_code='RUNNING' AND j.lease_expires_at>clock_timestamp() AND j.operation_code IN ('COLLECT','RETRY_FILES') AND j.set_id IS NULL AND s.classification_row_version=j.expected_source_version AND s.attachment_row_version=j.expected_attachment_version AND s.data_purpose_code='PRODUCTION' AND s.semantic_status_code<>'EXCLUDED' AND e.title_stage_code IN ('GROUP_A_MATCHED','COMBINATION_MATCHED')
mapper.insert: -- 바이너리를 삭제한 뒤 짧은 transaction으로 성공 텍스트만 보존한다. 원문/인증 URL은 감사 로그로 복사하지 않는다. INSERT INTO announcement_attachment_file_checkpoints(job_id,source_id,stable_locator_hash,file_result_json) SELECT j.id,j.source_id,#{locatorHash},CAST(#{fileJson} AS jsonb) FROM announcement_attachment_jobs j WHERE j.id=#{jobId} AND j.lease_token=#{leaseToken} AND j.job_status_code='RUNNING' AND j.lease_expires_at>clock_timestamp() AND j.operation_code IN ('COLLECT','RETRY_FILES') AND j.set_id IS NULL ON CONFLICT (job_id,stable_locator_hash) DO NOTHING
mapper.delete: -- 최종 set 봉인/연결과 같은 transaction에서 임시 중복 텍스트를 정리한다. 최종 근거는 삭제하지 않는다. DELETE FROM announcement_attachment_file_checkpoints WHERE job_id=#{jobId}
mapper.select: -- 다른 source의 set ID를 사용해 근거를 조회하지 못하도록 두 키를 함께 검증한다. SELECT id, source_id, content_version_id, policy_id, discovery_status_code, set_status_code, manifest_hash, profile_hash, discovered_count, processed_count, is_discovery_complete, created_at, discovered_at, sealed_at, discovery_warning_codes_json::text AS discovery_warning_codes_json FROM announcement_source_attachment_sets WHERE id = #{setId} AND source_id = #{sourceId}
-- 원문 범위의 근거 묶음만 집계한다. SELECT count(1) FROM announcement_source_attachment_sets WHERE source_id = #{sourceId}
-- 다른 source/set의 파일은 목록과 집계에 포함하지 않는다. SELECT count(1) FROM announcement_source_attachment_files WHERE source_id = #{sourceId} AND set_id = #{setId}

-- 파일별 가장 최근 추출 상태만 요약하며 원문 text/임시 locator는 반환하지 않는다. SELECT f.id, f.set_id, f.display_name, f.detected_type_code, f.document_role_code, f.role_origin_code, f.download_status_code, f.downloaded_bytes, f.binary_hash, f.error_code AS download_error_code, x.id AS extraction_id, x.quality_code, x.character_count, x.page_count, x.duration_ms, x.error_code AS extraction_error_code, x.created_at AS extracted_at,x.reused_from_extraction_id FROM announcement_source_attachment_files f LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT e.id, e.quality_code, e.character_count, e.page_count, e.duration_ms, e.error_code, e.created_at,e.reused_from_extraction_id FROM announcement_source_attachment_extractions e WHERE e.source_id = f.source_id AND e.set_id = f.set_id AND e.file_id = f.id ORDER BY e.attempt_no DESC, e.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) x ON true WHERE f.source_id = #{sourceId} AND f.set_id = #{setId} ORDER BY f.sort_order, f.id LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

-- PostgreSQL substring은 code point 기준이다. 한 block의 큰 본문은 별도 offset으로 나눠 조회한다. WITH blocks AS ( SELECT (b.item->>'index')::integer AS block_index, (b.item->>'startOffset')::integer AS start_offset, (b.item->>'endOffset')::integer AS end_offset, b.item->>'evidenceScopeId' AS evidence_scope_id, (b.item->>'scopeReliable')::boolean AS scope_reliable, b.item->>'locator' AS locator, x.extracted_text FROM announcement_source_attachment_extractions x CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(x.blocks_json) WITH ORDINALITY b(item, ordinal) WHERE x.source_id = #{sourceId} AND x.id = #{extractionId} ORDER BY b.ordinal LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset} ), excerpts AS ( SELECT block_index, start_offset, end_offset, evidence_scope_id, scope_reliable, locator, extracted_text, start_offset + LEAST(#{textOffset}, end_offset - start_offset) AS text_start FROM blocks ) SELECT block_index, start_offset, end_offset, evidence_scope_id, scope_reliable, locator, substring(extracted_text FROM text_start + 1 FOR LEAST(#{textLimit}, end_offset - text_start)) AS text, text_start, LEAST(end_offset, text_start + #{textLimit}) AS text_end, (text_start + #{textLimit} < end_offset) AS has_more FROM excerpts ORDER BY block_index
mapper.insert: -- source와 실행 계약을 고정한 OPEN 근거 묶음을 생성한다. INSERT INTO announcement_source_attachment_sets (id, source_id, content_version_id, policy_id, data_purpose_code, profile_hash) VALUES (#{setId}, #{sourceId}, #{contentVersionId}, #{policyId}, #{dataPurpose}, #{profileHash})

-- 임시 URL/원본 binary 대신 안전한 locator와 검증된 처리 metadata를 저장한다. INSERT INTO announcement_source_attachment_files (id, set_id, source_id, stable_locator_hash, safe_locator_json, display_name, detected_type_code, document_role_code, role_origin_code, download_status_code, downloaded_bytes, binary_hash, sort_order, error_code) VALUES (#{fileId}, #{setId}, #{sourceId}, #{locatorHash}, CAST(#{locatorJson} AS jsonb), #{displayName}, #{detectedType}, #{role}, #{roleOrigin}, #{downloadStatus}, #{downloadedBytes}, #{binaryHash}, #{sortOrder}, #{errorCode})

-- 추출 텍스트는 업무 근거 테이블에만 저장하고 감사 metadata에 복사하지 않는다. INSERT INTO announcement_source_attachment_extractions (id, file_id, set_id, source_id, attempt_no, extractor_code, extractor_version, extractor_config_hash, quality_code, extracted_text, text_hash, blocks_json, character_count, page_count, duration_ms, error_code,created_at) VALUES (#{extractionId}, #{fileId}, #{setId}, #{sourceId}, #{attemptNo}, #{extractorCode}, #{extractorVersion}, #{extractorConfigHash}, #{quality}, #{text}, #{textHash}, CAST(#{blocksJson} AS jsonb), #{characterCount}, #{pageCount}, #{durationMs}, #{errorCode}, COALESCE(#{completedAt,javaType=java.time.OffsetDateTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE},clock_timestamp()))
mapper.update: -- 파일별 성공/실패의 최종 근거를 모두 저장한 뒤 봉인한다. V72 trigger가 미완료 파일을 거부한다. UPDATE announcement_source_attachment_sets SET discovery_status_code = #{discoveryStatus}, is_discovery_complete = #{complete}, discovery_warning_codes_json = CAST(#{warningsJson} AS jsonb), discovered_count = #{count}, processed_count = #{count}, manifest_hash = #{manifestHash}, discovered_at = clock_timestamp(), sealed_at = clock_timestamp(), set_status_code = 'SEALED' WHERE id = #{setId} AND set_status_code = 'OPEN'

-- 늦은 worker 응답과 다른 lease는 새 set을 연결할 수 없다. 판정 완료 상태와는 구분한다. UPDATE announcement_attachment_jobs SET set_id = #{setId}, row_version = row_version + 1, updated_at = clock_timestamp() WHERE id = #{jobId} AND lease_token = #{leaseToken} AND lease_expires_at > clock_timestamp() AND job_status_code = 'RUNNING' AND set_id IS NULL
